PMFBY

The Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana provides crop insurance
coverage to eligible farmers according to the applicable scheme
guidelines.

PMFBY provides financial protection to farmers against eligible
crop losses caused by covered risks under the applicable scheme.

Grievance Redressal

Farmers may use the applicable grievance redressal mechanisms
specified in the official scheme guidelines.

title: Sample
text:
A grievance should be submitted through the appropriate
designated grievance redressal authority or mechanism.

Eligibility

Farmers must satisfy the applicable eligibility requirements
specified under the PMFBY scheme and relevant government
guidelines.

Application

Eligible farmers can apply for crop insurance through the
applicable enrollment channels and within the prescribed
enrollment period.

Premium

title: Sample
text:
The insurance premium payable by farmers is determined
according to the applicable PMFBY provisions and notified
rates.
